name: hiran-skills
description: Hiran Patel's personal Claude skills library for CV tailoring, interview prep, and job search workflows

plugins.name: cv-tailoring
plugins.description: Tailors a CV to a job description, scores ATS keyword coverage via semantic clustering, generates a timestamped DOCX, and logs the application to a Google Sheets tracker in GDrive. Includes board/investor, BI tool, and Design function assessment per role.

plugins.name: interview-prep
plugins.description: Builds interview intel from a JD and company name: company and named-interviewer research, STAR-format answers, smart questions baked with real company knowledge, an intro, and HR-screen basics. Multi-round aware via transcript debrief. Scales from a 10-minute rapid brief to a full dossier.
